name: Multi-plane Neural Rendering
aliases: Multi-plane Neural Rendering — 3D Convolutional Renderer, MPP Network, Neural Volume Rendering Network
Neural Point Cloud Rendering via Multi-Plane Projection
definition: A rendering technique using a U-Net-like 3D CNN backbone to predict multi-plane RGB images and blending weights, which are composited to form the final output image.
summary: Multi-plane Neural Rendering projects 3D point cloud features into a layered volume to let a 3D CNN learn visibility and handle occlusions, avoiding the noise and instability of direct 2D projection.
